_comment: Node SSR (was a static export served from out/). With the Vercel project Root Directory set to 'frontend', THIS file is the one Vercel reads. It must declare the nextjs framework and must NOT set outputDirectory:'out' - `next build` (SSR) emits .next, which Vercel serves natively; a stale outputDirectory:'out' made the deploy fail with 'No Output Directory named out found'. Security headers are applied by the Next server itself (next.config.mjs headers()); the block below is defence-in-depth on Vercel's edge.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http: https: ws: wss:; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
